name: Kharif Dry Spell Duration
source: ICAR-CRIDA District Agriculture Contingency Plan for Ahmednagar & Nashik
rationale: In Vertisols and medium black soils, moisture starts depleting rapidly after 7 rainless days during peak vegetative and flowering stages of soybean and bajra; beyond 14 days causes permanent wilting point stress in rainfed crops.

name: Rabi Terminal Heat Stress
source: MPKV Rahuri Wheat Research Scheme & IMD Agromet Advisory
rationale: Temperatures above 32°C during anthesis and grain filling drastically shorten duration of grain development, causing shriveled wheat kernels and up to 25% yield loss.

name: Vineyard Frost & Cold Injury
source: ICAR-NRC Grapes Pune & Maharashtra Rajya Draksha Bagaitdar Sangh Nashik
rationale: Night temperatures dropping below 6°C in Niphad/Dindori grape basins inhibit cell division, crack maturing table grape berries, and halt sugar accumulation.

name: 24-Hour Excessive Precipitation
rationale: Daily rainfall exceeding 75 mm leads to prolonged water stagnation in low-lying Vertisols, suffocating root systems of cotton, onion, and pulses, and inducing collar rot.

name: Grape Downy Mildew Weather Window
high_threshold: RH > 85%, temp 20-26°C, continuous leaf wetness > 4 hours
rationale: Plasmopara viticola requires continuous free moisture on grape leaves for at least 4 hours at moderate temperatures for zoospore encystment and stomatal infection.

name: Root-Zone Hydration Deficit
source: NASA POWER & SMAP Root Zone Soil Moisture Integration
rationale: Root zone wetness below 0.30 triggers stomatal closure, spike in VPD, flower drop in soybean and cotton, and requires immediate supplementary protective irrigation.

name: Taluka Groundwater Exploitation Level
source: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB) Dynamic Ground Water Resources of Maharashtra 2023
rationale: Over-exploited talukas (e.g., Sangamner, Sinnar, Kopargaon) experience borewell discharge dropping by 60% in summer, making high-water crops like sugarcane unsustainable.

name: Onion Mandi Price Crash Alert
source: Agmarknet Historical Mandi Data & Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP)
rationale: Estimated cost of cultivation for rabi/summer onion in Nashik and Ahilya Nagar is approximately ₹1200-1400 per quintal. Mandi prices below ₹1200 cause direct capital erosion to growers.
